title: ItayOst homepage: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Till Tape. Keep it, take my pick or an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Till Tape
options.lineage: thermal register receipts from every Israeli shop counter
options.thesis: Your business's chaos, printed out as one clean itemized system.
options.viewport: A long receipt prints down the page: messy inputs (WhatsApp, Excel, notebook) itemized, subtotal becomes 'one system', stamped with a live 'reply by HH:MM' and the WhatsApp action.
options.risk: Mono receipt type can feel cold or cheap if the paper, ink fade and stamp are not crafted with care.

raised.raise: The end-of-roll magenta commits as a full field that owns whole regions, not a sprinkled accent.
Every section heading uses a fixed three-tier stack: the pain, the fix, the promise.
The page is time-indexed: timestamps and the reply-by stamp are computed from the visitor's real clock.
One scroll-driven print timeline drives all motion; nothing animates on its own.
Everything is measured on one strict tape column with dot-leaders; no floating cards anywhere.

options.label: The Carbon Order Pad
options.lineage: duplicate order pads (פנקס הזמנות) with carbon copies
options.thesis: The handwritten pad every business runs on, re-issued as a system.
options.viewport: A torn pad sheet with scribbled orders; the carbon copy underneath shows the same order as a clean CRM record, with the WhatsApp action on the sheet.
options.risk: Handwriting and paper textures can tip into cute or Wix-like; it is also the closest to what a model would pick first.

options.label: Cereal Aisle Planogram
options.thesis: Services as box facings on a saturated shelf.
options.viewport: A shelf of service boxes, CRM box pulled proud.
options.risk: Reads childish; owners do not see their business in it.
options.case: Fuses poorly: loses audience identification and hides the systems offer.
options.kept: Total commitment of one saturated color field.

options.label: Pulp Paperback Rack
options.thesis: Each service a lurid cover promising drama.
options.viewport: A face-out cover for the CRM service.
options.case: Fuses poorly: wrong register for a trusted local builder.

options.label: Rain Night Cityscape
options.thesis: The business as a lit city of connected systems.
options.viewport: Skyline with lit windows as automations.
options.risk: Dark neon drifts into the SaaS look to avoid.
options.case: Fuses poorly: abstract, and close to the banned template look.
options.kept: Time-indexed state tied to the visitor's clock.

options.label: Paper Automata Crank
options.thesis: One crank turns the whole business.
options.viewport: A crank that sets leads, orders and invoices moving.
options.case: Fuses partly: good automation metaphor, weak audience identification and clarity.
options.kept: A single timeline drives every motion.

options.label: Ebru Marbling
options.viewport: A fluid canvas combed into order.
options.risk: Artsy; offer and action get lost.
options.case: Fuses poorly: too artsy to convert.
options.kept: One continuous surface, no card shells.

options.label: Oscilloscope Bench
options.thesis: Noisy business signal locked into a clean trace.
options.viewport: A noisy trace that locks when the system is on.
options.case: Fuses poorly: engineer's world, not the owner's.
options.kept: Everything measured against one strict grid.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean freelance-studio site: founder photo, service grid, project gallery, contact.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and CTA beside a portrait or product mockup, service cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other developer site by design.
